what: One short bar per chapter (time range) of the Hero video — the bar for the current chapter fills from the left in step with video time, is full at 92% of the chapter, then at that moment slides down 101% over .5s, shrinks to 0 and disappears. Each chapter change fires fx:chapter(detail.index) so scenes and text can be hooked to it. With no video it runs on a clock of length seconds

options.[data-fx-part=bar] > [data-fx-part=fill]: Bar and the filling cell inside it (if none, the bar itself fills)
options.cuts: Section start·end (seconds) separated by commas — ”0 5.26, 5 10.6, 10.34 16.6, 16.34 22” (brand). If absent, length is divided equally by the number of bars
options.length: One loop (sec) when running without video, default end of last segment
options.video: Video selector to read the time from — if empty, the first one inside the part <video>, and if that’s missing, the clock
options.target: Selector for the element that fires fx:chapter, default is this element (spreads upward)
options.--fx-w · --fx-h · --fx-gap: Bar width, thickness and gap (via style), default 20px · 3px · 10px

from.where: index.html .py-hero__bars (Hero KV video four-scene progress bars — the original uses video timeupdate)
